info.title: Aqua local API
info.description: Generated from the router's source and from core/src/api_gateway/contract_schemas.rs by a test; do not edit by hand. Aqua listens on 127.0.0.1 only. `x-aqua-token` says which token a route needs: `none`, `api` (the API token) or `ui` (the UI token: it can approve actions and read what the person asked). `x-aqua-typed` says whether the request and the answer of a route are described by a schema (`false`: the body is not described yet). Every error body is `Error`: its `code` is one of documentation/ERROR_CODES.md. Every answer carries the header `x-aqua-contract`, the number in `x-aqua-contract` below.

ErrorCode.description: What went wrong, in a word that does not change (documentation/ERROR_CODES.md).

Error.description: The body of every error answer.

Untyped.description: The body is not described yet: it is a JSON object, and what it holds is in the document of the route.

Version.description: Which core this is and which contract it speaks.

Health.description: What a caller with no token is told: up, and which version. A caller with a token is told the whole Status.

VoiceSecurityStatus.description: Whether speaker verification can do its job.

Status.description: Whether Aqua is up, which engines are ready and how startup ended.

llm_gpu_off.description: Why the graphics card is being left alone, and until when.

items.description: The model one role uses and why.

models.description: The models found in the models folder.

PipelineTextResponse.description: The answer of a turn, with its sound.

question.description: A question the agent asks and waits on: text and choices (the UI token's answer only).

TurnRun.description: Which run the turn is, and where to read it again (event `run`).

TurnStep.description: What the agent is doing (event `step` of a voice or text turn).

TurnApproval.description: A question that needs the person's answer (event `approval`, the UI token only).

TurnDone.description: The result of the turn (event `done`): the fields of PipelineTextResponse (a voice turn's has its own, see UI_CONTRACT.md), and how it was streamed.

question.description: The question the agent waits on.

AgentStep.description: One step of a run: a phase, a call of a tool or what the model said.

AgentResult.description: What an agent run came to.

gate.description: What the gate decided about the request.

items.description: A page the answer cites: id, url, title, date.

JobStarted.description: A background run that was accepted (202), or the one started the first time (200, duplicate).

AgentStreamRun.description: Which run the stream is of (event `run`).

AgentStreamStep.description: One step, in full for the UI token and reduced for any other (event `step`).

step.description: The step: number, kind and what the token may see of it.

AgentStreamConfirmation.description: A question that needs the person's answer (event `confirmation`, the UI token only).

AgentStreamError.description: The run could not be made (event `error`).

RunStartRequest.description: A run that is not tied to the connection.

tools.description: Which of the two outside tools the run may use.

PreapprovalRequest.description: A pre-approval of a project's checks for one run (UI token; the core must run with AQUA_PREAPPROVALS=on).

Preapproval.description: A pre-approval as it was just made: with whether the terminal tools trust its folder (a check in a folder that is not trusted asks as it always did).

PreapprovalView.description: A pre-approval: what is left of it.

RunStarted.description: A run that was accepted (202), or the one started the first time (200, duplicate).

RunStep.description: One step of a recorded run: a call of a tool or a reply of the planner, with its arguments masked.

Run.description: A run with all its steps (the UI token).

items.description: One item of the checklist: text and status.

AnswerRequest.description: The answer to a question a run ended with: exactly one of the two.

AnswerResponse.description: What the run that went on from the answer came to.

question.description: The next question, when it asks again.

RunInterrupted.description: A run that was told to end.

MessageRequest.description: A line said to a run: one line, at most 500 characters.

MessageAccepted.description: What became of a line said to a run: added to the next step (`queued`), kept for after the run (`kept`) or the run was stopped by it (`stopped`).

RunQueue.description: What was said to a run and is waiting.

RunWait.description: Where a run stands: `finished` is true once it has ended (and, for a detached run, its outcome is written down).

ActiveRuns.description: The runs that are not over.

items.description: A run that is going or waits.

ResumeRequest.description: What to do about the calls that were running when the run stopped.

ResumeResponse.description: What the run that went on came to; or, for `unknown: stop`, that the run will not be offered again.

question.description: The question the run asks and waits on.

UndoResponse.description: What the undo did (or would do), and what no undo can reach.

SteerRequest.description: A line for the task that is running.

RunEvent.description: One event of a run, as a stream or a page gives it: the envelope (v, id, seq, run_id, ts, type) and the fields of its type. The fields that show what a call was given or returned, and a question, are sent to the UI token only.

request.description: The question, with the exact action and its target (the UI token only).

RunEventsPage.description: A page of a run's events: ask again with `after=<last>` until `finished`.

ToolCallRequest.description: A call of one tool of the tool host.

ToolResult.description: The envelope every tool call answers with, whatever the status code: `error` is an object with the tool host's own codes (not the codes of ErrorCode).

approval.description: How the question about the call was answered.

error.description: What went wrong with the call.

QueueJob.description: A background run as the queue shows it.

JobCancelled.description: The state a background run was left in.

JobsList.description: The background jobs of the core.

items.description: A job: name, kind, state, last sign of life.

CommandsList.description: The commands that can be started (off unless AQUA_COMMANDS=on).

items.description: A command: name, description, hint, where it came from.

AgentsList.description: The agents there are: the built-in ones, yours, and those of a project whose .aqua text you trusted (off unless AQUA_AGENTS=on).

items.description: An agent: name, description, mode, where it came from, the tools it allows, its packs and limits; never the words of its instructions.

FlagsList.description: The typed flags: name, kind, default, what each is now.

Cancelled.description: The running agents were told to stop.

TaskStopped.description: The task that was running was stopped.
